label: COUNTS-ONLY amendment (2026-10-31): tensor-contraction IC (ic.tensor_contraction_v1, m = 2) against rho.negation and the prime IC baseline on the registered bench-roster prime curves of 10, 12, 14 and 16 bits (counted S only, no wall time)
description: Supersedes, for counted S only, docs/ecbench/specs/tensor-ic-vs-rho.json and docs/ecbench/specs/tensor-ic-vs-rho-16.json (both left frozen and unchanged). Same curves, targets (target_seed 20261030, 8 per curve), arms and arm methods; only measurement changes: isolation_required L0, rounds 1, warmup 0. Reason: on EKS the run-ecbench L2 gate grades any solve under 1 ms as L1 (record.rs MIN_SOLVE_WALL_NS_V3) and exits 42, and rho at 10-16 bits solves in microseconds (run gh-41008826427-1: 176/192 records L1). Counted S is deterministic per (workload, algorithm seed) and replayable exactly, so it needs no wall isolation; L0 is the level ecbench documents as sufficient for operation counts. No wall-time figure from this session is a result. Caveat: on 64-bit builds lambda <= 64, root_u = lambda/131072 = 0 and public inputs take the finite-size fallback; nothing here exercises the recursive subexponential kernel; ic.tensor_contraction_v1 is an exponential toy (protocol H1). Protocol: research/hashed_ecdl_counts_20261031/protocol.json.
